data.narrative:
Orbital Operations is a Seed-stage space & aerospace company founded by Ben Schleuniger and Ross Doherty that has raised $8.8M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 5 public companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE, though narrow-filter peer median is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints within acceptable valuation bands.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. Using the $8.8M total raised as a proxy for intrinsic value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement in this sector yields an implied valuation of $22M. Public comparables in Space & Aerospace trade at a 27.4x median price-to-sales, but this anchor cannot be calibrated without the target's revenue, which remains undisclosed.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $19M to $25M, with a central estimate of $22M. Key uncertainties include the absence of disclosed revenue data, which precludes public-comp anchoring and limits precision; the extreme heterogeneity of the private space sector, which yields few true peer matches; and reliance on a single applicable method. A revenue disclosure or near-term financing event would materially improve confidence in this range.
